definition: Solar, wind or other renewable systems, with or without storage, powering sites that have no grid connection. Does not include sites connected to the grid, or replacing an existing diesel generator.

Solar or other renewable generation installed at sites that are also on the grid, to supply part or all of their electricity. Does not include off-grid sites or buying renewable electricity from others.
Replacing existing diesel generation, or hybridising it with renewables, at sites that now run on diesel. Choose this when replacing diesel is stated, whether or not the site is on the grid.
Maintenance, spare parts, technician training or remote monitoring of renewable systems the project installs, to keep them working over their life. Does not include installing the systems.
Buying electricity from renewable sources (power purchase agreements, green tariffs) rather than generating it on site. Does not include on-site generation.
Generates solar electricity at or for a project-supported location
Combines solar generation with battery storage
